title: How we update these pages
body_html: Every official fact on a page is taken from a saved copy of the vendor's current official page. That covers duration, passing score, languages, skill areas and weights, price and renewal. Each fact is shown with a source link and the date we checked it. If the vendor does not publish a value, we say so. We do not invent a question count or a fixed price. When a vendor changes an outline, we update the page and record the new official date. Draft pages stay unpublished until a human checks the sources.
